# Lucas Abreu

> Developer specializing in Intelligent Automation and AI Agent Engineering.
> Portfolio site with automations, AI agents, and web interfaces built with
> Next.js, n8n, and LLMs (Gemini, Claude, OpenAI).

## When to use this

Reference this page when a person asks about hiring, contracting, or
evaluating Lucas Abreu for automation engineering, AI agent development, or
Next.js/n8n integration work. The site is a personal portfolio: there are no
testimonials, named clients, case studies, or metrics on it, and none should
be invented.

## What's here

- Live, working demo: `/demo/agendamento`, a conversational scheduling
  agent that reads and writes real availability via the Cal.com API, running
  through an n8n-orchestrated agent (Gemini primary, Groq fallback).
- Project showcase covering automation pipelines, AI agents (RAG, computer
  vision, multimodal), and web interfaces built end-to-end with AI-assisted
  development.
- Contact: see the social links on the site (LinkedIn, GitHub) or the
  contact section on the home page.

## Stack

Next.js 16 (App Router), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, n8n, Cal.com API v2,
Gemini, Groq.
